mapper.sql: select d.id as deviceId, d.tenant_id as tenantId, d.company_id as companyId, c.company_name as companyName, d.station_id as stationId, s.station_name as stationName, d.controller_id as controllerId, ctl.device_name as controllerName, d.device_code as deviceCode, d.device_name as deviceName, d.device_type as deviceType, d.rated_capacity as ratedCapacity, d.model, d.serial_no as serialNo, d.manufacturer, d.firmware_version as firmwareVersion, d.last_heartbeat_time as lastHeartbeatTime, d.controller_version as controllerVersion, d.install_date as installDate, d.comm_status as commStatus, d.status, dc.server_endpoint_id as serverEndpointId, dc.edge_id as edgeId, dc.component_id as componentId, dc.component_type as componentType, dc.component_alias as componentAlias, dc.serial_no as bindSerialNo, dc.parent_edge_id as parentEdgeId, dc.parent_component_id as parentComponentId, dc.bind_time as bindTime, dc.unbind_time as unbindTime, dc.bind_status as bindStatus, dc.bind_source as bindSource, dc.last_sample_time as lastSampleTime, case when dc.component_id is null or dc.component_id = '' then null else concat(ifnull(dc.component_alias, ''), '(', dc.component_id, ')') end as componentBinding, d.create_time as createTime, d.update_time as updateTime, d.remark from ems_device d left join ems_company c on c.id = d.company_id and c.del_flag = '0' left join ems_station s on s.id = d.station_id and s.del_flag = '0' left join ems_device ctl on ctl.id = d.controller_id and ctl.del_flag = '0' left join ems_device_component dc on dc.device_id = d.id and dc.del_flag = '0' and dc.bind_status = 'ACTIVE' where d.del_flag = '0'

when.test: (scope.companyIds != null and scope.companyIds.size() > 0) or (scope.stationIds != null and scope.stationIds.size() > 0)

sql.if: and (d.serial_no like concat('%', #{query.serialNo}, '%') or dc.serial_no like concat('%', #{query.serialNo}, '%'))
